# GLOSSARY.md Format

Create `GLOSSARY.md` when future lessons need shared terms. Add a term after
the learner shows that they can use it correctly.

```md
# {Topic} Glossary

## Terms

### {Term}

{Definition in one or two sentences.}

Avoid: {Other terms that could cause confusion.}
```

Use one preferred term for each concept. Explain an ambiguous use. Revise a
definition when the learner's understanding changes. Use glossary terms
consistently in lessons and learning records.
